response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), qualifying AS (SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex, sa.avg_modindex - oa.avg_modindex AS above_overall_average FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE sa.avg_modindex > oa.avg_modindex) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, above_overall_average, avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qualifying) AS difference_from_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying;
